# hmrc

> Provides functions to download, parse, and tidy statistical data published by 'HM Revenue and Customs' ('HMRC') on 'GOV. Install with `install.packages("hmrc")`.

Full API reference (for agents): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/charlescoverdale/hmrc/main/llms-full.txt

Version: 0.3.3. License: MIT.

## Functions

- [`clear_cache()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/clear_cache.html): Clear the local HMRC data cache
- [`get_corporation_tax()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/get_corporation_tax.html): Download HMRC Corporation Tax receipts by type
- [`get_fuel_duties()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/get_fuel_duties.html): Download HMRC hydrocarbon oil (fuel duty) receipts
- [`get_income_tax_stats()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/get_income_tax_stats.html): Download HMRC Income Tax liabilities by income range
- [`get_property_transactions()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/get_property_transactions.html): Download monthly UK property transaction counts
- [`get_rd_credits()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/get_rd_credits.html): Download HMRC R&D tax credit statistics
- [`get_stamp_duty()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/get_stamp_duty.html): Download HMRC stamp duty receipts
- [`get_tax_gap()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/get_tax_gap.html): Download HMRC tax gap estimates
- [`get_tax_receipts()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/get_tax_receipts.html): Download HMRC tax receipts and National Insurance contributions
- [`get_tobacco_duties()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/get_tobacco_duties.html): Download HMRC tobacco duty receipts
- [`get_vat()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/get_vat.html): Download HMRC VAT receipts
- [`list_tax_heads()`](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/list_tax_heads.html): List available tax heads in the HMRC Tax Receipts bulletin

## Documentation

- [Full reference](https://charlescoverdale.github.io/hmrc/reference/)
